guidance.intro: Tips for keeping your model-assisted labeling workflow healthy:
guidance.step1: 1. <italic>Validate the setup:</italic> send a quick test request to make sure the backend answers correctly.
guidance.step2: 2. Re-sync often so annotators always see the most recent predictions.
guidance.step3: 3. <italic>Retrain regularly:</italic> schedule training after major annotation batches to keep models fresh.
guidance.prelabeling: Want predictions in the interface? Enable them in <link>Annotation settings</link>.
